summary: Warns that editors can leak vault secrets via swap, backup and clipboard files and lists vim settings (noswapfile, nobackup, nowritebackup, viminfo=, clipboard=) and Emacs settings to disable clipboard, backups and autosave.
questions: Can ansible-vault edit leak secrets through my editor?
Which vim settings should I use when editing vault files?
How do I stop Emacs from making backup files of vault content?

answer_card.title: Secure your editor for Vault
answer_card.answer_md:
Editors may write plaintext copies (swap, backup, clipboard). Configure them to avoid this.

**vim**:
```text
set noswapfile
set nobackup
set nowritebackup
set viminfo=
set clipboard=
```
Add to `.vimrc` for all files or specific paths.

**Emacs**:
```text
(setq x-select-enable-clipboard nil)
(setq make-backup-files nil)
(setq auto-save-default nil)
```

This isn't exhaustive, especially with plugins; check your editor docs.
